note: Iowa DNR park on 85-acre Lake of Three Fires, about 3 mi north of Bedford. Electric sites on a wooded main loop, a non-electric loop to the north, and a separate equestrian camp with corrals and access to the park's horse trails; showers and a dump station, six studio cabins, beach and boat ramp. No daily Iowa park-entry fee, camping fee only. --Claude
summary: Sites 140 -> 51 (23 electric + 3 buddy fit; 24 non-electric are 15 ft; equestrian camp separate), electric 50 added, max 126, pull-throughs; booking fcfs some_sites -> never (100% reservable). Not waterfront stands. No split. Pin ~255 m off.
flags: NO SPLIT: DNR's 'two modern campgrounds' are the electric main loop (1-42, with the non-electric west lobe 31-42) and the non-electric north loop (43-56), ~215 m apart; the equestrian camp (57-85) is ~160 m east of the main loop. All three hang off the same park road from one registration point. Well under 1 km, no separate entrance.

NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: the electric sites (the only ones a 23-ft rig fits) sit on the main loop ~145 m+ from the lake through continuous forest (imagery estimates, Overpass down). The north loop's west end (52-53) and the west lobe near the boat ramp come closer to the water, but those are non-electric sites posted at 15 ft, under trees. RA tags every campsite 'Near Water - no' (79 of 79), a blanket default.
BOOKING: stored fcfs some_sites -> never. ReserveAmerica: '100 percent reservable ... until 10:00 pm CST the day of arrival.'
